quests.title: Mine Craft

dialogue.t: Drat. Running out of ores, are we...

dialogue.sit: Can I ask you some questions about finding ores?

dialogue.t: Ores? What do you want to forge? Weapons or armor?
If you're looking to mine ores, I do know some good spots.
There are all sorts of ores, though. Iron Chunks are the most common, followed by White Iron Chunks, and then Crystal Chunks...
And there's Magical Crystal Chunks, which are of very fine quality, and can be used to forge excellent items.
However, they are very difficult to work with. If you want to make anything with them, you'll have to expend a significant amount of other resources as well.
Still, I've just come back from a trip outside, and it seems that most of the ore veins have already been mined. If you go out now, I doubt you'll get anything.
Hmm, how about this? Come find me later, and I'll mark all the veins I know of on your map.
Hmm, how about this — I'll mark the locations of all the veins I know of on your map.
If you need anything, go and mine it yourself. If you forget where they were, you can come and ask me again.
That said, you'll probably learn them by heart after you go mining a few times.
Magical Crystal Chunks are very hard to mine, however... Hmm, how about this — I'll mark all the positions I know of on your map.
If you can't find any Magical Crystal Chunks, Crystal Chunks should make a good compromise.
Alright then, I've marked your map for you. If you need any ores, go mine them yourself. If you forget their positions, you can come and ask me again.
That said, you'll probably learn them by heart after you go mining a few times.

quests.description: Mining is not an easy task… But perhaps Mondstadt’s blacksmith, Wagner, might have some tips for you…
